thumbnail_prompt: ONE image, both arms. The VIEWER living the moment, never a performer - measured 6.11% CTR for waking/stretching in bed vs 3.03% for a musician playing. Early morning light through a window, a person just sitting up in bed mid-stretch, eyes closed, calm and unhurried. Pichwai/Kangra miniature treatment, aged parchment ground, ornate border. A sitar may rest at the frame edge but must NOT be the subject. Text in its own banner panel at ~35% of frame, second tier reads 'Sitar · Raga Ahir Bhairav'. Legible at 120px.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming - warm Indian classical sitar in Raga Ahir Bhairav, bright resonant strings with sympathetic drone, unhurried gentle tabla, the feeling of first light entering a quiet room, 68 BPM, soft alpha undertone.
suno_prompt_note: Morning/uplifting lane KEEPS energy - the calm-prompt rule applies to sleep/anxiety/rest lanes only. Tabla is correct for Sitar (never for Bansuri or Surbahar). ~260 chars, the banked short one-liner default. Ahir Bhairav last used 2026-08-03, 42 days clear.
